payout_quote: Earn up to $300 cashback, along with monthly rewards when you move your checking account to Cornerstone Community Financial Credit Union.
steps: Open a new Rewards Checking account at Cornerstone Community Financial Credit Union
Set up a recurring monthly direct deposit of at least $500 into the new account
Complete 10+ eligible debit or credit card purchases each month (tap-to-pay, digital wallet, and non-PIN debit purchases count; PIN, ATM, and cash advance transactions do not)
Opt in to eStatements and log in to mobile or online banking at least once each month
Meet all four qualifications in each of the first three full calendar months after account opening; $100 is paid the month after each qualifying month, up to $300 total
catches: If qualifications are not met in a month, no cashback is paid for that month - the full $300 requires three qualifying calendar months
Qualification period runs on full calendar months: accounts opened mid-month start qualifying the following month
Requires a real recurring monthly direct deposit of $500+
Offer may be changed or discontinued at any time - no fixed end date
Eligible purchases exclude PIN, ATM, and cash advance transactions
Must be eligible for Cornerstone Community Financial Credit Union membership (Michigan and parts of Ohio)
biggest_catch: This is a 3-month grind, not a quick bonus: you must hit all four qualifications (real $500/month direct deposit, 10+ card purchases, eStatements, monthly login) in each of the first three full calendar months, and missing any month forfeits that month's $100.
eligibility: New Rewards Checking accounts at Cornerstone Community Financial Credit Union; must be eligible for credit-union membership (Michigan and parts of Ohio).
timing: $100 cashback paid the month following each qualifying calendar month, up to $300 total across the first three full calendar months after opening.
weasel_words: May be changed or discontinued at any time
